target: tracker.sh report — the new column is strictly additive
cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: plain
status: queued
---
body
' > factory/specs/001-a.md; printf -- '---
id: 002
title: waiting
status: queued
depends_on: 010
---
body
' > factory/specs/002-b.md; printf -- '---
id: 010
title: dep
status: building
---
body
' > factory/specs/010-c.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; R="$(tracker_report)"; N1="$(printf '%s' "$R" | awk -F'\t' '$2=="001" {print NF}')"; N2="$(printf '%s' "$R" | awk -F'\t' '$2=="002" {print NF}')"; T1="$(printf '%s' "$R" | awk -F'\t' '$2=="001" {print $3}')"; jq -n --arg n1 "$N1" --arg n2 "$N2" --arg t1 "$T1" '{n1: $n1, n2: $n2, t1: $t1}'
_note: a spec with nothing wrong still emits exactly three fields, and a merely-waiting one exactly four — the stalled: column appears only when there is something dead to name. Anything already reading status/id/title positionally keeps working.
